Hey there @mammuth, @aarondavidschneider, mind taking a look at this pull request as it has been labeled with an integration (`fritz`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L178) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

> seems to work :D Great job!

Thx for testing!

> 1. Is the braking change of renaming necessary? -> old sensor is not removed automatically

Good point, we should remove it.
Is a breaking change because if you have lovelace or an automation/alert based on it, after upgrading it won't work anymore.

> 2. What is the difference between link and connection? Can we document this?

Indeed, doc PR is missing, usually I wait the core one to be ready for merging before opening ;-)

Link = the physical xDSL link
Connection = stablished internet connection 

> I think we need to list the firmware update sensor as breaking change?!

Is a new feature, why should it be listed as breaking change in your opinion ?

Simone

> Is a new feature, why should it be listed as breaking change in your opinion ?

agree. But as a proposed change? Anyway, the most important thing is that users know what these sensors are actually doing :D

issue_context.title: Fritzbox Tools is_connected is_linked
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Before merging the fritz_netmonitor into tools, there were the attributes 
- is_connected
- is_linked

During merge and change from attributes to entities, these two are not available anymore. But they were helpful to distinguish different kind of errors before, because is_connected <> is_linked.

Merging is fine, removing information and function, not really. ;-)

Can you bring back, what was there before´? If attribute on main entity or extra entities, that doesn't matter for me.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.8.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2021.7.x

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

AVM FRITZ!Box Tools

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/fritz/
